info.name: Hospital Management API
info.description: Multi-hospital API. Fresh database: run Initial Platform Admin Setup, log in as platform admin without a hospitalId, create a hospital, then log in as the hospital admin created during hospital provisioning. Hospital admins create users under their token hospital.

item.name: File Upload
item.description: Uploads a profile image to Cloudinary. Requires a patient bearer token. Accepted formats: JPEG, PNG, WEBP, and GIF; maximum size: 5 MB.

item.name: Profile Photo
item.description: Use profileToken, saved by any Authentication login request, to read or manage the signed-in user's photo.

item.name: User Directory
item.description: Lists users in the selected hospital only. Set userDirectoryToken to a valid bearer token for that hospital. Password hashes are never returned.

exec: pm.test('User directory returns users for the selected hospital', function () {

item.name: Get User By ID
item.description: Uses userId from the environment. Run a role login or create a user first to populate it.

exec: pm.test('User lookup returns the requested user without credentials', function () {

item.name: Authentication
item.description: On a fresh database, create a platform admin account without creating a hospital. Log in as the platform admin, then create hospitals separately in the Admin folder. Hospital-scoped user creation uses the hospital admin token hospital.

item.name: List Hospitals (select before login)
item.description: Returns active hospital IDs, names, and codes. The test selects hospitalId if already set; otherwise it selects the first hospital. Change hospitalId in the environment to work with another hospital.

exec: pm.test('Active hospital list is returned', function () {

item.name: Initial Platform Admin Setup (run once)
item.description: Fresh database only. Creates only the first PLATFORM_ADMIN account. Set adminName, adminEmail, and adminPassword. Then log in as the platform admin and create a hospital separately using Admin > Hospital Management > Create Hospital.

item.name: Admin Login
item.description: Logs in and saves the JWT as adminToken for the Admin folder requests.

exec: pm.test('Platform admin login returns a token', function () {

item.name: Contact Number Login
item.description: Logs in using a user's registered contact number, password, and hospitalId. Set loginContactNumber, loginPassword, and hospitalId in the environment. Email-based login remains supported.

exec: pm.test('Contact number login returns a token', function () {

This flow does not send an email, WhatsApp, or SMS. Set recoveryContactNumber, recoveryDateOfBirth, and recoveryNewPassword; use recoveryEmail instead of recoveryContactNumber if recovering by email.

exec: pm.test('Forgot password request returns success', function () {

item.name: Admin
item.description: Platform admins use adminToken to create hospitals. After provisioning, run Hospital Admin Login before hospital-scoped user and appointment requests.

item.name: Hospital Management
item.description: Platform admins create hospitals separately from their platform account. Hospital-specific operations use a hospital admin token.

item.name: Create Hospital (Platform Admin)

exec: pm.test('Hospital and first hospital admin are created', function () {

item.description: Platform admin only. Creates a hospital and its first ADMIN account in one transaction. The response returns hospitalId and admin details. The platform admin is not added as a hospital member.

item.name: User Management
item.description: Hospital admins create accounts for their selected hospital. The hospital is taken from the bearer token; do not send hospitalId in this request. Set newUserRole to ADMIN, DOCTOR, PATIENT, NURSE, or MEDICAL_STAFF.

item.name: Create User

exec: pm.test('User created with requested role and token hospital', function () {

item.description: Creates the user in the hospital selected by the bearer token. Do not send hospitalId; the response includes it. Specialization is optional and used for doctor accounts.

item.name: Authorization Checks
item.description: Role-denial checks. Run Admin Login and Patient Login first.

exec: pm.test('Unauthenticated user creation returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

item.name: Reject User Creation With Patient Token

exec: pm.test('Non-admin user creation returns 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: Reject Patient Profile Read With Admin Token

exec: pm.test('Admin role cannot access patient-only profile routes', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: Deny Unconfigured API Route By Default

exec: pm.test('Authenticated request to an unconfigured API route returns 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: Appointments
item.description: Availability workflow: doctor sets a two-month schedule and working hours; patients check the date and list open slots; booking uses an open slot and creates a PENDING appointment for the doctor's later decision.

item.name: Availability Lookup (Hospital Users)
item.description: Use the token saved by the most recent login. Any authenticated user with membership in the selected hospital can look up that hospital's doctor availability.

item.name: Get Doctor Availability Calendar (Paginated)
item.description: Returns saved available and explicitly unavailable dates for the doctor, ordered by date. Dates without a saved availability record are not included. page is zero-based; size defaults to 20 and is limited to 100.

item.name: Patient
item.description: Run Authentication > Patient Login first.

item.name: Book Appointment For Myself

exec: if (!appointmentAt) { throw new Error('Run Get Open Appointment Slots first to select a free slot.'); }

item.description: Books using appointmentAt saved by Get Open Appointment Slots. The doctor must be available on that date, and pending or scheduled appointments block overlapping slots.

item.name: Reschedule My Appointment
item.description: Reschedules to an open appointment slot. First run the doctor's availability slot lookup for the target date; it saves the selected slot start in appointmentAt.

item.name: Delete My Appointment
item.description: Deletes an appointment only if the signed-in patient is its patient. Uses appointmentId saved by the booking request or set manually.

exec: pm.test('Patient deletes own appointment', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });

item.name: Check Doctor Availability By Date
item.description: Checks whether the selected doctor marked this date available.

item.name: List Available Doctors By Date
item.description: Lists doctors in this hospital who marked the selected date available.

item.name: Get Open Appointment Slots
item.description: Returns open 20-minute slots separated by 10-minute breaks. Saves the first slot start as appointmentAt for booking.

item.name: Nurse
item.description: Run Authentication > Nurse Login first. Nurses cannot book appointments in this API; use this request to confirm the server denies the operation. Set patientId and doctorId in the environment.

exec: pm.test('Nurse appointment booking is forbidden', function () {

item.name: Delete Assigned Appointment (Expected 403)
item.description: Nurses cannot delete appointments. Use a real appointmentId to verify the role restriction.

exec: pm.test('Nurse cannot delete appointments', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: Doctor
item.description: Run Authentication > Doctor Login first.

item.name: Accept Pending Appointment
item.description: Accepts a pending appointment assigned to the signed-in doctor. Uses appointmentId saved by the patient booking request or set manually.

item.name: Reject Pending Appointment
item.description: Use this instead of Accept Pending Appointment for a pending appointment assigned to the signed-in doctor.

item.name: Reschedule Assigned Appointment
item.description: Reschedules to an open appointment slot. First run the doctor's availability slot lookup for the target date; it saves the selected slot start in appointmentAt.

exec: pm.test('Doctor appointment time is updated', function () {

item.name: Delete Assigned Appointment
item.description: Deletes an appointment only if it is assigned to the signed-in doctor. Uses appointmentId saved by booking or set manually.

exec: pm.test('Doctor deletes assigned appointment', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });

item.name: Get My Availability (Paginated)
item.description: Returns the signed-in doctor's saved available and unavailable dates. No doctorId is needed. page is zero-based; size defaults to 20 and is limited to 100.

item.name: Set Availability Schedule (up to 2 months)
item.description: Doctor sets recurring available weekdays, working hours, and date overrides for a range up to two months. Set scheduleStartDate and scheduleEndDate in the environment.

item.name: Update Availability For One Date
item.description: Mark the signed-in doctor available or unavailable on a date. Optional working hours define appointment slots for that date.

item.name: Consultation Workflow
item.description: Doctor-only, hospital-scoped workflow. Start after accepting an appointment (status SCHEDULED). Save sections in order. Each successful response returns an ETag; use it in If-Match for the next write to prevent overwriting another edit.

item.name: Start or Resume Consultation
item.description: Requires a doctor token and appointment assigned to that doctor with status SCHEDULED. Idempotently creates or returns the consultation.

exec: pm.test('Consultation started or resumed', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('consultationId', body.id); pm.environment.set('consultationVersion', pm.response.headers.get('ETag') || String(body.version)); });

item.name: Get Consultation
item.description: Fetches current consultation data and refreshes the version used for optimistic concurrency.

exec: pm.test('Consultation loaded', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('consultationVersion', pm.response.headers.get('ETag') || String(body.version)); });

item.name: Save Diagnosis and Clinical Assessment
item.description: Step 1. Required: primaryDiagnosis, diagnosisType (SUSPECTED or CONFIRMED), severity (MILD, MODERATE, SEVERE, CRITICAL), symptoms. Optional: medicalHistoryContext, assessmentNotes. Upload reports through Upload Diagnostic Document.

exec: pm.test('Diagnosis saved', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('consultationVersion', pm.response.headers.get('ETag') || String(body.version)); });

item.name: Upload Diagnostic Document
item.description: Optional. Choose a PDF/JPEG/PNG/WEBP file in Postman form-data key file (maximum 5 MB). Requires current If-Match. The response adds document metadata under diagnosisData.documents.

exec: pm.test('Diagnostic document uploaded', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('consultationVersion', pm.response.headers.get('ETag') || String(body.version)); const docs=(body.diagnosisData && body.diagnosisData.documents) || []; if(docs.length) pm.environment.set('documentId', docs[docs.length-1].id); });

item.name: Save Patient Evaluation
item.description: Step 2. Required: examinationNotes. Optional: generalAppearance, systemicFindings, additionalTests, vitals object. Vitals may include bloodPressureSystolic, bloodPressureDiastolic, pulseRate, temperatureC, respiratoryRate, oxygenSaturationPct, weightKg, heightCm, bmi.

exec: pm.test('Patient evaluation saved', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('consultationVersion', pm.response.headers.get('ETag') || String(body.version)); });

item.name: Save Care Plan
item.description: Step 3. Required: treatmentSummary. Optional: medicationGuidance, lifestyleGuidance, followUpDays (nonnegative integer), followUpNotes, investigations array, warningSigns.

item.name: Save Fees
item.description: Step 4. Required: consultationFee. Optional procedureCharges, facilityFee, discountAmount, taxAmount (default zero), paymentStatus (PENDING, PAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, WAIVED, REFUNDED), paymentChannel, billingRemarks. totalAmount is computed by the server.

exec: pm.test('Fees saved', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('consultationVersion', pm.response.headers.get('ETag') || String(body.version)); });

item.name: Save Prescription
item.description: Step 5. prescriptionNotes is optional; medicines is an optional list. Each medicine requires medicineName, dosage, timing, duration; instructions is optional. An empty medicines list is allowed.

exec: pm.test('Prescription saved', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('consultationVersion', pm.response.headers.get('ETag') || String(body.version)); });

item.name: Complete Consultation
item.description: Final action. All five sections must be valid and saved. Marks consultation and appointment COMPLETED. Requires current If-Match.

exec: pm.test('Consultation completed', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body=pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('consultationVersion', pm.response.headers.get('ETag') || String(body.version)); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); });

item.name: Get Diagnostic Document Download Link
item.description: Returns a short-lived signed Cloudinary URL for an uploaded diagnostic document. Document access is restricted to the assigned doctor.
